title: Why Does Synergistic Activation of WASP, but Not N-WASP, by Cdc42 and PIP 2 Require Cdc42 Prenylation?
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究无序蛋白WASP/N-WASP与Cdc42及PIP2膜的多调控因子协同结合机制，揭示Cdc42异戊二烯化对WASP激活的特异性需求，直接聚焦IDP介导的蛋白-膜/蛋白互作机制建模，对本课题有高度启发。
abstract: Human WASP and N-WASP are homologous proteins that require the binding of multiple regulators, including the acidic lipid PIP 2 and the small GTPase Cdc42, to relieve autoinhibition before they can stimulate the initiation of actin polymerization. Autoinhibition involves intramolecular binding of the C-terminal acidic and central motifs to an upstream basic region and GTPase binding domain. Little is known about how a single intrinsically disordered protein, WASP or N-WASP, binds multiple regulators to achieve full activation. Here we used molecular dynamics simulations to characterize the binding of WASP and N-WASP with PIP 2 and Cdc42. In the absence of Cdc42, both WASP and N-WASP strongly associate with PIP 2 -containing membranes, through their basic region and also possibly through a tail portion of the N-terminal WH1 domain. The basic region also participates in Cdc42 binding, especially for WASP; consequently Cdc42 binding significantly compromises the ability of the basic region in WASP, but not N-WASP, to bind PIP 2 . PIP 2 binding to the WASP basic region is restored only when Cdc42 is prenylated at the C-terminus and tethered to the membrane. This distinction in the activation of WASP and N-WASP may contribute to their different functional roles.
abstract_zh: 人源WASP和N-WASP是同源蛋白，需要结合多种调控因子，包括酸性脂质PIP 2和小GTP酶Cdc42，以解除自身抑制，才能刺激肌动蛋白聚合的起始。自身抑制涉及C端酸性基序和中央基序与上游碱性区域及GTP酶结合域内的分子内结合。关于单一内在无序蛋白WASP或N-WASP如何结合多种调控因子以实现完全激活，目前知之甚少。在此，我们利用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来表征WASP和N-WASP与PIP 2及Cdc42的结合。在缺乏Cdc42的情况下，WASP和N-WASP均通过其碱性区域，并可能通过N端WH1结构域的尾部部分，与含PIP 2的膜强烈结合。碱性区域也参与Cdc42结合，尤其是对WASP而言；因此，Cdc42结合显著削弱了WASP（而非N-WASP）碱性区域结合PIP 2的能力。只有当Cdc42在C端异戊二烯化并锚定于膜上时，WASP碱性区域与PIP 2的结合才得以恢复。WASP和N-WASP在激活上的这一差异可能有助于它们不同的功能角色。
